name: Punctuation Practice
description: Eight short lines with commas, quotes, colons and other punctuation to get comfortable with.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight lines of everyday punctuation to practise, shown on Typing Drills.
help.goal: Just practice. Take your time with each mark.
howToPlay: Type the line shown, including the punctuation.
Correct characters are underlined and mistakes are struck through.
At the end of a line the next one appears.
tips: Use Start line over if a line gets tangled. What you type never leaves this page.
